questions.q: Choose the correct modal: “The seminar is optional; you ____ attend if you are occupied.”
questions.why: 'Needn't' means there is no obligation. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2026.

questions.q: Choose the correct tense: “I ____ him since he was a child.”
questions.why: 'Since' with a past clause needs the present perfect; 'know' is a stative verb, not used in the continuous. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: “The Collector is not satisfied ____ the progress of the work.”
Choose the word closest in meaning to “benevolent”:
questions.why: Benevolent = well-meaning and kind. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Select the correct indirect speech: She said, “What a beautiful garden!”
opts: She said what a beautiful garden it was!
She asked that it was a beautiful garden.
She exclaimed that what a beautiful garden.
She exclaimed that it was a very beautiful garden.
questions.why: Exclamations become 'exclaimed that … very …'. GPSC-style practice item.

opts: My brother who is a surgeon, lives in Pune.
My brother, who is a surgeon; lives in Pune.
My brother, who is a surgeon, lives in Pune.
My brother, who is a surgeon lives in Pune.
questions.why: A non-defining clause is enclosed by a pair of commas. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: “I will lend you the book provided that you ____ it by Monday.”
questions.why: 'Provided that' takes the present tense for future reference. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: “Ten kilometres ____ a long distance to walk.”
questions.why: A distance considered as one unit takes a singular verb. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to “scarcity”:
questions.why: Opposite of scarcity is abundance (plenty). GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the meaning of the idiom “the last straw”:
opts: the final event that makes a situation unbearable
questions.why: From 'the straw that broke the camel's back'. GPSC-style practice item.
